interface.vectors: Unsigned packed vectors [width-1:0]; no additional ports

semantics.clock: All state updates on positive clk edge, except asynchronous active-high areset
semantics.state: 7-bit global history and 128 two-bit PHT counters
semantics.prediction: Combinational predict_history equals current global history; predict_taken equals MSB of PHT[predict_pc XOR current history]. No training bypass. Outputs are continuously driven; meaningful prediction is requested with predict_valid.
semantics.prediction_update: On rising edge with predict_valid, shift history left one bit and append pre-edge predict_taken as bit 0
semantics.training: On rising edge with train_valid, update PHT[train_pc XOR train_history] toward train_taken, regardless of train_mispredicted
semantics.recovery: train_valid AND train_mispredicted overrides prediction history update: history becomes {train_history[5:0], train_taken}
semantics.idle: History holds without prediction or valid recovery; PHT holds without valid training
semantics.collision: Simultaneous prediction and training read old counter before the rising edge; only after that edge does the training update become visible
semantics.reset_initialization: Asynchronous reset clears history to 0 and sets every PHT counter to 2'b01, taking precedence over all requests. No power-up initial construct.

numeric.counter_encoding: Unsigned 00 strongly not taken, 01 weakly not taken, 10 weakly taken, 11 strongly taken; direction is bit 1
numeric.saturation: Taken increments unless already 3; not taken decrements unless already 0; no wraparound
numeric.history: Discard previous bit 6 on shift; newest branch direction occupies bit 0

verification.gate: Run python3 validate_contract.py and require successful passed_structure_only before writing RTL
verification.tools: Icarus v12 with -g2012 and explicit dev_tb top; matching vvp; finite shell timeouts
verification.oracle: Independent integer counter array and integer history model; compare public combinational outputs before and after every active edge
verification.directed: Asynchronous reset off-edge, reset every PHT index, counter thresholds and both saturation endpoints at every index, same-entry read before write, speculative history shift, misprediction recovery priority, invalid training, idle hold
verification.random: Deterministic randomized PCs, histories, outcomes, and valid/misprediction controls, plus reset during activity
verification.scope: Development verification only; no official testbench, synthesis, board access or official evaluation results

specification_ambiguities.issue: Reset state values not explicitly specified
specification_ambiguities.resolution: Assume global history 0 and all counters weakly not taken (01)

specification_ambiguities.issue: History shift direction not explicitly specified
specification_ambiguities.resolution: Append newest outcome as bit 0, discard oldest bit 6

specification_ambiguities.issue: Output behavior while predict_valid=0 not specified
specification_ambiguities.resolution: Continuously expose current history and indexed prediction; valid only gates speculative state update
